players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Cal Raleigh placed on the 10-day IL with a right oblique strain, his first career IL stint. Earliest return is estimated May 24, with Mitch Garver and Jhonny Pereda handling catching duties in Seattle.

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Cole Ragans remains on the 15-day IL with left elbow impingement (valgus extension overload), placed May 8. He threw off a mound on May 16 with increasing intensity, a positive sign toward his return.
